segments.name: Construction
segments.description: Designs and manufactures modular structures using recycled shipping containers for residential, commercial and industrial applications.
segments.evidence: The construction segment designs and constructs modular structures in our factory using recycled shipping containers; in the past, traditional wood and steel frames were also used.

segments.name: SaaS
segments.description: Offers turnkey solutions to monitor oil and gas operations remotely and other similar applications through IoT technology.
segments.evidence: In the technology sector, we offer turnkey solutions to monitor oil and gas operations remotely and other similar applications.

segments.name: Oil and Gas
segments.description: Operates oil and gas wells in multiple states and in Canada, and provides renewable energy services.
segments.evidence: Our oil and gas wells operate in multiple states and in Canada.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for modular construction projects, IoT remote monitoring solutions, and oil and gas production.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's remaining backlog as of December 31, 2025 represents the remaining transaction price of firm contracts for which work has not been performed.

changes.text: In February 2025, the company executed an agreement to merge with New Asia Holdings, Inc., acquiring Olenox Corp., Machfu Inc., and Giant Containers Inc.
changes.evidence: On February 2, 2025, we executed a sign and close agreement to merge Olenox Industries Inc. ("OLOX") with New Asia Holdings, Inc. ("NAHD"), the parent company of Olenox Corp. and Machfu, Inc.

changes.text: In December 2025, OLOX acquired Giant Containers Inc., a leading global manufacturer of modular structures.
changes.evidence: In December 2025, OLOX acquired Giant Containers Inc.
